messages:
sam: Short postmortem follow-up  we need clear owners and a two-week plan for the streaming reliability issues we keep seeing: long inter-chunk gaps, silent partials that never finish, and reconnect storms during rollouts. Put very small ETAs so we can surface progress at next retro.

mia: I'll take observational work + detector. Plan: implement a 'chunk_gap' meter (p50/p90/p99) per session and an event when gap > 7000ms without terminal error. Will wire dashboard and a composite alert (p90 gap > 4s && rate > 0.2%). ETA: 3d (Thu AM). Ticket RW-9201.

rahul: I'll own server-side KV prewarm + soft-evict window. Hypothesis: cold evictions during pressure cause trailing gaps. Quick change: add a soft-evict window (10s) and async prewarm on heavy sessions. ETA: 5d (next Tue EOD). Ticket RW-9202.

leo: I'll do the deployment safety work: a canary gate script that samples chunk_gap.p90 for 10m and aborts if it moves >2s above baseline or exceeds absolute threshold. Also add a short rollback script to traffic-shed streaming routes back to synchronous endpoints for affected customers. ETA: 4d (Mon). Ticket RW-9203.

ops-bot: Created RW-9201 (mia) https://tracker.redwood.ai/RW-9201, RW-9202 (rahul) https://tracker.redwood.ai/RW-9202, RW-9203 (leo) https://tracker.redwood.ai/RW-9203

sam: Devex / SDK defaults for reconnect/backoff are cross-cutting. Devex should publish recommended values that balance thundering vs user-perceived latency. Can we get an owner?

devex: I'll own the SDK defaults and docs. Proposal: maxRetries=3, baseBackoff=400ms, cap=6s, jitter factor 0.25 (capped). I'll include examples in python/js and migration notes. ETA: 2d (Wed). Ticket RW-9204.

mia: Draft metric schema I'll attach to RW-9201:```json
{"event":"chunk_gap","session_id":"string","gap_ms":"int","node":"string","deployment":"string","chunk_index":"int","reason":"string_optional"}
```

rahul: Fast remediations we can flip this week while longer work is in progress: 1) increase heartbeat frequency from 18s -> 9s for suspect fleets, 2) enable ephemeral KV replication on hot ranges, 3) add a temporary deploy guard that samples session gap rate and prevents large-scale rollouts. Who picks which?

leo: I'll own the deploy guard and rollback script (RW-9203). Will also add a small canary dashboard tile.

rahul: I'll own replication toggle + prewarm rollout plan. Will stage in low-risk regions first. ETA: Tue morning for toggle. Opening RW-9205 for the toggle.

devex: I'll push SDK sample PR and include recommended client-side heartbeat alignment (client heartbeat slightly shorter than server tolerance). Example snippet for JS:```js
// jittered exponential backoff
function retryDelay(attempt){
  const base = 400;
  const cap = 6000;
  const raw = Math.min(base * Math.pow(2, attempt), cap);
  const jitter = raw * (1 - 0.25 + Math.random()*0.5);
  return Math.round(jitter);
}
// maxRetries = 3
```

ops-bot: Created RW-9204 (devex) https://tracker.redwood.ai/RW-9204, RW-9205 (rahul) https://tracker.redwood.ai/RW-9205

sam: Two administrative asks: 1) add one-line impact estimate to each ticket for the leadership brief (e.g., "expected to reduce partial-stream alerts by ~30% in canary") and 2) owners please post a 1-line blocker if any.

mia: One-liner for RW-9201: "exposes silent gaps and enables automated canary aborts and rollback triggers; expected initial coverage +35% on canaries."

rahul: RW-9202 one-liner: "soft-evict + prewarm expected to cut tail inter-chunk gaps under memory pressure by ~40% in load tests."

leo: RW-9203 one-liner: "canary gate and rollback reduce blast radius during rollouts; aborts early if chunk-gap p90 spikes."

devex: RW-9204 one-liner: "SDK defaults smooth reconnect storms and spread retries to reduce server-side thundering."

sam: Blockers?

mia: Need observability ingestion quota for the new chunk_gap metric. Please file quota ticket or tag infra.

rahul: Possible blocker: prewarm requires a small memory budget increase for nodes; I'll surface exact numbers in RW-9202 but may need infra approval.

leo: No blockers on canary script; will reuse existing CI hooks.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled for 3412345678 in 72 hours.

sam: Checklist I'm adding to the retro doc (owners + ETA + ticket):
- chunk_gap metric + detector + alert: mia  Thu AM  RW-9201
- soft-evict + KV prewarm: rahul  Tue EOD  RW-9202
- canary gate + rollback script: leo  Mon  RW-9203
- SDK reconnect defaults + samples: devex  Wed  RW-9204
- replication toggle (fast rem): rahul  Tue AM  RW-9205

sam: React with :white_check_mark: if you accept and add any small blockers inline. I'll pull this into the leadership note and the retro packet.

mia: :white_check_mark: Accepted. Quota ticket needed (tagging infra please).

rahul: :white_check_mark: Accepted. Will detail the memory delta in RW-9202 today.

devex: :white_check_mark: Accepted. No blockers.

leo: :white_check_mark: Accepted. No blockers.

sam: Thanks team. If anything slips, post a one-line update here and I'll refresh the retro summary.
